notes.title: "Continue" bug
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the "Continue" button from the start menu would not work if you had empty save slots.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the "Continue" button from the start menu would not work if you had empty save slots.

notes.title: Minor improvements
notes.content:
Added some minor improvements such as:
[list]
[*] Can pass dialog by pressing Ctrl, Space, Enter or Mouse click
[*] Blackboards now stay after the end of dialogs, until you press once again, as was intended
[*] There was a bug where after loading the game in the first level, the dialog about the energy barrier would still play. Fixed that.
[*] Re-arranged text when launching new game to fit better the user's screen resolution
[/list]
